设计意图： Replaces the binary volatility regime switch with a continuous blend of short-term reversal and long-term momentum, weighted by relative volatility. When volatility is very low, the factor leans on mean-reversion; when volatility is very high, it leans on momentum; in between, it smoothly combines both signals. 🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义

ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close.pct_change()
  2. 计算 vol：ret.滚动窗口(20).std()
  3. 计算 vol_median：vol.滚动窗口(40).median()
  4. 计算 weight：(vol / vol_median).clip(0, 1)
  5. 计算 weight：weight
  6. 计算 mean_rev：-ret.shift(1)
  7. 计算 momentum：close / close.shift(20) - 1
  8. 计算 raw：(1 - weight) * mean_rev + weight * momentum
  9. 计算 raw：raw.滚动窗口(5).mean()
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_volatility_regime_blend(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change() vol = ret.rolling(20).std() vol_median = vol.rolling(40).median().replace(0.0, np.nan) weight = (vol / vol_median).clip(0, 1) weight = weight.fillna(0.5) mean_rev = -ret.shift(1) momentum = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(20) - 1 raw = (1 - weight) * mean_rev + weight * momentum raw = raw.rolling(5).mean() df_copy["factor_volatility_regime_blend"] = raw "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_volatility_regime_blend"]
